segments.caption: A shirtless young man wakes up in his bedroom, checking the time on a digital clock that reads 8:15. He sits up in bed, then gets on the floor to put on his pants and socks. After dressing, he stretches on the floor, pulling his leg up and then into a deep lunge position, before standing up and beginning to dance energetically in front of his computer desk.

A young man quickly gets dressed in his room, pulling on his shirt and shoes while sitting on the floor, then stands, adjusts his shirt, and rushes out the door with his backpack, heading toward an elevator to leave the building.
A young man with a backpack walks through a building, enters an elevator, and then exits to a bus stop, where he waits among other passengers as a bus passes by.
A young man with a backpack navigates his daily commute, starting in an elevator, then running to catch a bus at a roadside stop, and finally entering a subway station to wait for his train.

A man with a backpack hurries through a transit environment, first waiting at a platform as a train passes, then quickly exiting the station through a covered walkway and ascending stairs, before bursting into a sunlit courtyard of a building, suggesting he is rushing to a destination.

A person with a backpack performs a dynamic, parkour-style sequence through an urban environment, moving from a grassy area under a covered walkway, climbing over walls and ledges, executing a powerful jump across a courtyard, and then vaulting over a low wall into a narrow alleyway, showcasing agility and fluid motion throughout.

A young man in a white shirt and light pants, carrying a backpack, executes a series of agile parkour movements through an urban courtyard and alleyway, leaping over walls, vaulting under structures, and sprinting with purpose between buildings and concrete barriers.
A person performs an agile parkour sequence, scaling a brick wall, running across a courtyard, and vaulting over a railing before disappearing down a set of stairs.

A person with a backpack is seen running energetically through an urban environment, navigating various structures including a ramp, stairs, and an elevated walkway, before sprinting down a tree-lined path.

A young man in a school uniform and backpack is seen descending a set of stairs, then running down a tree-lined path. The scene cuts to him inside a building, visibly distressed as he struggles to adjust his tie, suggesting he is rushing to get somewhere important or is reacting to a sudden, urgent situation.
A student in a school uniform, adjusting his tie and putting on his glasses, walks confidently across a sunlit school courtyard, pausing to look upward as if preparing for or reacting to something.

A student in a school uniform walks through a campus courtyard, then stops and begins gesturing animatedly as if explaining something. As he speaks, days of the week appear in sequence around him, starting with "MON" and expanding to include "TUE," "WED," "THU," "FRI," "SAT," and "SUN," visually representing the passage of time or a weekly schedule.

A young man in a school uniform and glasses, carrying a backpack, is shown in a sequence that begins with him speaking and gesturing while days of the week appear as text overlays. He then turns and walks away from the camera down a covered walkway, with the credits for the video rolling over his retreating figure.

The video opens with a credit sequence over a blurred background showing a person walking away from the camera down a tiled walkway framed by pillars and greenery. The credits acknowledge the director/editor (Nachos), the music composer (John Paul Balthazar Kwan), and the camera operators (Fok Jun Yi, Marcus Chang, Jeroen Ow, Shaun Ng).
